title: Gideon and the Will
author: Coral Nakamura
blurb: Ulyana Villalobos, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
